title: FactorIA effect document (*.vfx.json)
description: A reusable visual effect: several emitters, a light flash, sounds and commands (a camera shake, a hit-stop) on one timeline. `vfx.play` (and `vfx.play()` in scripts) plays it at a position or on an entity; an entity with a `Vfx` component plays it from a scene like a prefab. Errors name the file and the JSON pointer; `vfx.check {path}` lists every problem. docs/PARTICLES.md, "Effect documents", explains the format.

doc.description: What the effect is and where the game plays it.

duration.description: Length of the effect in seconds. Left out: until the last part has started and ended. A part that starts after it is an error.

parts.description: What the effect does, each part at its own time. At most 16 parts, 8 of them emitters and 8 of them commands.

type.description: What the part is. emitter: a ParticleEmitter child entity. light: a Light2D (or Light with is3D) that fades out. sound: a one-shot clip. command: a call to one of the allowed game feel or audio playback commands (feel.shake, feel.hitStop, feel.flash, feel.knockback, feel.squash, feel.spawn, feel.sound, audio.bus, audio.snapshot, audio.music).

name.description: Name of the child entity an emitter or a light becomes (letters, digits, '_' and '-'); unique in the effect. Default: the type and the index of the part ("emitter0").

at.description: Seconds after the effect starts that the part starts. A speed above 1 on the Vfx or vfx.play brings it earlier.

duration.description: emitter: seconds it keeps emitting its `rate` after the burst (0, the default: only the burst). light: seconds it lasts (default 0.2; it fades out over it). sound and command: not used.

offset.description: emitter, light: [x, y] or [x, y, z] relative to the effect's position. Default [0, 0, 0].

emitter.description: emitter parts, required: the fields of a ParticleEmitter component (docs/PARTICLES.md and docs/COMPONENTS.md list them), checked against the component with the same errors as a scene. `emitting` and `autoDestroy` are set by the effect. A part needs a `burst`, or a `rate` with the part's `duration`, or it emits nothing and is an error.

light.description: light parts: the fields of a Light2D (or of a Light when is3D is true), e.g. {"color": "#ffe9a0", "intensity": 2, "radius": 160}. Its `intensity` is the peak; the part fades it to 0 over its duration.

is3D.description: light parts: true makes a 3D point Light instead of a Light2D.

fade.description: light parts: a curve (position 0..1 over the light's life, the form of a ParticleEmitter sizeCurve, e.g. [[0, 1], [1, 0]]) that multiplies the intensity. Left out: a straight fade from 1 to 0.

clip.description: sound parts, required: the audio file (project path) played once.

pitch.description: sound parts: playback speed, 1 = as recorded.

bus.description: sound parts: the mixer bus, "sfx", "music", "ui" or a bus of the project.

command.description: command parts, required: the command to call, by its exact name: feel.shake, feel.hitStop, feel.flash, feel.knockback, feel.squash, feel.spawn, feel.sound, audio.bus, audio.snapshot or audio.music. Any other command is an error, so an effect file cannot write files or change settings (audio.bake, audio.create, feel.settings and the rest are refused).

args.description: command parts: the arguments of the command, e.g. {"amount": 0.5}.
